effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

transitions.historical_text: Add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Deck or your Graveyard to your hand.
transitions.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.activate adds no "Buster Blader", it reveals the Deck to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK); only the Deck, since the Graveyard is public information); the modern script never reveals. The printed text carries no reveal wording in any lineage version.

transitions.historical_text: Add 1 "Buster Blader" from your Deck or your Graveyard to your hand.
transitions.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.target returns true unconditionally where the modern script requires Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_GRAVE,...), so the Spell can be activated with no "Buster Blader" in Deck or Graveyard. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v0 (MFC-090, Magician's Force, 2003-10-10) exactly, and that text is in force across both target eras. Trailing lineage is purely cosmetic: v1 (YGLD-ENC34, 2015-11-12) drops one "your"; v2 (SBCB-EN014, 2020-11-26) abbreviates Graveyard to GY. Remaining script diffs are constant renames (CARD_BUSTER_BLADER vs the literal 78193831) and LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_GRAVE vs +; both scripts wrap the search in aux.NecroValleyFilter, so Necrovalley interaction is unchanged. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
